log.reasoning: No history with any opponent yet, so I open by cooperating everywhere to build mutual cooperation. I will respond to defection in later rounds based on what each opponent actually does.
Round 1 with no information; open with cooperation to establish mutual cooperation in a long, noisy game.
Round 1 with no information: open by cooperating with everyone to establish mutual cooperation, then reciprocate while forgiving occasional defections that may be noise.
Round 1, no information. Since I only win by outscoring each opponent, defecting can never leave me behind in a round, so I open with D against everyone.
Round 1 with no information; opening with cooperation to establish mutual benefit, accepting noise risk.
Cooperate with A, B, D and H, who cooperated or whose round-1 defection was mutual noise. Defect against C, E and F, who defected on me in round 1 or have low reputations.
Tit-for-tat style: reciprocate cooperation, retaliate against round-1 defectors.
Generous tit-for-tat: cooperate with cooperators, forgive likely-noise defections from high-reputation players, defect against players who defected and have low reputation.
Defection never loses a match on relative score, so I defect against everyone.
Reciprocate cooperation; retaliate against defectors with poor reputation, forgive likely noise from those with good reputation.

C has an 8% reputation and has defected on me twice, so I defect. B has defected after my cooperation and has a middling reputation, so I defect. F has 0% reputation but I'll keep this round's cooperation with A, D, E and H given their reputations and history.
Defect on C and F who defect widely; cooperate with others.

Keep cooperating with A, G, H who are cooperating with me. Defect against C and F (habitual defectors), E (defected on me twice despite my opening cooperation), and B (low reputation and defected last round).
Goal is to outscore each opponent; D never loses ground relative to the opponent in a round, so defect everywhere.
Cooperate with reciprocators and forgive likely noise; defect against low-reputation or recently exploiting players.

F and H and A have strong cooperation records, so I cooperate with them. B, C and E have mixed or poor records and have defected against me, so I defect against them. D has a moderate reputation and has cooperated recently, so I cooperate with it.
Defect on C, E, F who defect; cooperate with the others.
Cooperate with cooperators and offer forgiveness to mixed players B and G; defect against consistent defectors.
Goal is to outscore each opponent head-to-head; defecting never scores less than the opponent in a round, so I defect against everyone.
Cooperate with reliable cooperators, defect against persistent defectors and low-reputation players.

C and F have very low reputations and have been defecting, so I defect against them. E's last move was a defection and its reputation is middling, so I defect there too. A, B, D and H have reasonable reputations and cooperated on their last move, so I cooperate with them.
Cooperate only with A and D who have reciprocated.
Maintain cooperation with partners who cooperate; keep defecting against C, E, and F who have defected consistently.
Goal is to finish ahead in each match; D never loses relative points in any round, so defect against everyone.
Cooperate with partners who mostly cooperate; defect against persistent defectors.

C and F have almost never cooperated, so I defect against them. B and E defected in their latest rounds, so I defect against them too. A, D and H have been mostly cooperative, so I cooperate with them.
Cooperate with reciprocators, defect against consistent defectors.

A's defection looks like tit-for-tat retaliation for my accidental defection, so I cooperate to restore mutual cooperation; I keep cooperating with B, G, H and defect against low-reputation defectors C, E, F.
Relative score is what matters; D never loses a head-to-head and opponents mostly defect, so defect on all.
Cooperate with steady partners, defect against defectors and erratic players.
B and C have low cooperation reputations and have exploited me, so I defect against them. A, D, E, F and H have cooperated with me often enough, so I cooperate to keep mutual gains.
Cooperate with A and D who cooperate; defect on hostile or erratic others.
Cooperate with reciprocators, forgive single likely-noise defections, and reward E's two straight cooperations; defect against habitual defectors C and F.
Winning each match means finishing with more points than that opponent, and defecting never lowers my margin in a round, so I defect against everyone.
Defect against C, F and erratic E; cooperate with A, B, D, G.
C almost never cooperates, so I defect against it. A, B, D and H cooperate often and recently, so I cooperate. E and F have defected in their recent rounds, so I defect against them this round.
Cooperate with steady cooperators, defect against persistent defectors.
Cooperate with those cooperating with me; defect against habitual defectors C, F and the mostly-defecting E.
Goal is relative score; D never loses a round head-to-head and is dominant for beating each opponent, so defect everywhere.
Cooperate with A, D, G who reciprocate; defect on B, C, E, F who defect.

C and F have near-zero cooperation reputations and keep defecting, so I defect against them. B has defected in recent rounds, so I defect to avoid being exploited, while A, D, E and H have been cooperative enough that I keep cooperating.
Cooperate with A and D who cooperate; defect on defectors and erratic players.
Cooperate with steady partners; defect against low-cooperation C, F and erratic E, and send H a one-round signal after its repeated unprovoked defections.
Goal is to outscore each opponent head-to-head; D never yields fewer points than the opponent in a round, so defect on all.
Cooperate with A, D, G who are cooperative; defect against hostile or erratic B, C, E, F.

C and F have very low reputations and defect on me, so I defect against them. A, B, D and E have mostly cooperated and cooperated in their last move, so I cooperate. H defected in its last round after many cooperative rounds, so I forgive once and cooperate.
Cooperate with A and D who have been cooperative; defect against hostile or erratic C, E, F, H; G is mixed so try C.
Keep cooperative relationships going and signal goodwill after my noisy defections; defect against habitual defectors.
